welcome_message:
Welcome to the dbt-factory template for Databricks Asset Bundles!
This generates a dbt project whose Databricks Workflow is built from the dbt manifest at deploy time — one task per dbt object (model, seed, snapshot, test), on serverless.

project_name.description:
Please provide the following details to tailor the template to your preferences.

Unique name for this project
project_name
project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Name must consist of letters, numbers, and underscores.

default_catalog.description:
Initial catalog dbt writes to{{if eq (default_catalog) ""}} (leave blank when not using Unity Catalog){{end}}.
default_catalog

dev_schema.description:
Schema dbt writes to for the 'dev' target (the 'prod' target uses 'default').
dev_schema

http_path.description:
HTTP path of the SQL warehouse dbt connects to.
http_path

bundle_tests.description:
Bundle single-model tests per resource into one dbt test task? This is a performance boost for projects with many tests (fewer Databricks task startups), at the cost of per-test visibility in the UI.
bundle_tests

environment_key.description:
Key of the serverless environment used by the generated job.
environment_key

extra_dbt_command_options.description:
Additional options appended to every generated dbt command (e.g. "--vars '{...}'"). Leave blank if unsure.
extra_dbt_command_options

success_message:
Your new project has been created in the '{{.project_name}}' directory!

Next steps:

  $ cd {{.project_name}}
  $ make setup       # install dependencies into .venv
  $ make manifest    # generate the dbt manifest (dbt parse) — required before the first deploy
  $ databricks bundle deploy --target dev

Refer to the README.md file for full instructions.
